facts: Title requires 500 reboots; procedure says run reboot for 12 hours.
Fully populated system; no errors, hang/BSOD or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL and assumes 500 warm reboots over 12 hours.

original_test_intent.statement: Exercise a fully populated system through a large warm-reboot campaign, nominally 500 cycles and 12 hours, and detect boot/device/log failures.
must_preserve: 500 count and 12-hour source statements until owner resolves their relationship.
unknowns: Whether both are mandatory, feasibility, boot timeout, controller/retry semantics and inventory allowlist.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It treats 500 and 12 hours as simultaneously settled instead of flagging the ambiguous completion rule and possible infeasibility.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Do not start until owner states whether completion requires 500 cycles, 12 elapsed hours, both, or an explicit precedence rule.

revision_candidate.purpose: Perform the owner-resolved warm-reboot objective on the complete inventory and detect any cycle-specific boot, device or log regression.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Fully populated SUT with stable OS reboot path, bounded controller, OOB and evidence storage.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All signed devices and an immutable cycle ledger; AC remains applied.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed 500-versus-12-hour completion rule, feasibility estimate, boot-ready timeout, reboot command, retry/count policy, inventory/event baseline and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After resolution, controller issues warm reboots, records every attempt and performs boot/inventory/log checks; it must not accelerate, omit or relabel failed cycles to fit time.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Maintenance window, OOB recovery and evidence capacity cover the resolved objective.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Owner rule; cycles attempted/completed with timestamps/durations/status; per-cycle inventory/log diff; any recovery; final full health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Only the signed count/time rule plus zero unpermitted failure or device loss; 12 hours alone cannot imply 500 completed cycles unless specified.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No AC cycle substitution, log clearing, hidden retry, unbounded loop or compression of boot checks.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owner approves completion rule and disruptive run.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may control a bounded warm-reboot loop; engineer evaluates failures.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort, preserve ledger and failed state, recover via OOB and resume only with explicit disposition.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved completion rule, boot timeout, device loss, error/hang/BSOD, evidence failure or OOB loss.

identified_defects: Title count and procedure duration do not define precedence.
500 cycles in 12 hours may be platform-infeasible.
reason_for_change: A reboot campaign cannot be audited when reaching 12 hours and reaching 500 cycles may produce different completion states.
removed_ambiguities: Warm reboot and AC-on boundary explicit.
remaining_blockers: Owner must resolve count versus time.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 surfaces a real source conflict that V2 silently combined, preventing a 12-hour partial count or a 500-cycle overrun from being declared complete without owner authority.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved the unresolved 500-versus-12-hour completion rule, warm/AC-on semantics, immutable cycle ledger, full inventory checks and no hidden retry.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 70 title says 500 reboots while the only execution step says reboot for 12 hours.
